If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.5 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.5 and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1–3% for early horizon.  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon.  
If sentiment is <0.5 and forecast is flat, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon.
